domestic_evidence: Company website states "Muvall Castors is a castor wheel and caster wheel manufacturer in Bengaluru, India" with "Our factory is in Rajajinagar, Bengaluru, with stock points in Chennai and Bhiwandi" and claims "2500+ Customers 1M+ Castors Supplied 150+ Dealers 40+ Years of Experience"; no GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender award, no contract or annual-report split was retrievable (thecompanycheck.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; web_search backend was down for this session).
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data, but only as an IMPORTER: 1798 records, latest 2026-02-07, all visible lines are inbound casters from Zhongshan Feida Caster Co. (China) into Bangalore ICD under HS 87169090 / 83022000 — i.e. the company appears to be a trader/assembler of Chinese casters rather than a producer of its own. Declared HS 401390 (other rubber tyres/tubes) does not match the observed trade codes 87169090 (parts of trailers/vehicles) and 83022000 (castors of base metal); per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual code should be corrected to 83022000/87169090 and verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected. No dated export bill of lading, no destination-country export record and no domestic GST/tender evidence found; the four foreign counterparty names (Abu Dhabi, Oman, USA, one unnamed) are unverified aggregations and are treated as 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue and export volume: null (not public). Следов подтверждённых поставок (ни экспортных, ни внутренних) не найдено — только импортные записи.
